text.p: An investor group that includes members of Xpedite Systems Inc's senior management on Monday said they submitted a proposal of acquire the company at a price of $22.50 a share.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group, which made it's intentions known earlier this year, said it submitted the offer on Monday to Merrill Lynch & Co. The firm was hired by the company earlier this year to assist in evaluating such a plan.
The group said in the SEC filing that it's proposal is conditioned upon the simultaneous acquisition of Expedite's European affiliates, receipt of financing and shareholder and regulator approvals.
However, the group said in the SEC filing that it has received commitment letters from financial institutions to help fund the proposed transaction.
The investor group currently holds 666,531 shares or a 7.18 percent stake in Expedite.
